narrative.intro: Tutor Perini has obligated $252M in federal contract obligations in FY2026 to date. Tutor Perini has won 13 awards so far this fiscal year, with an average award size of $19.4M and year-over-year change up 745.8%. Tutor Perini recorded obligations in prior fiscal years as follows: FY21 $127M, FY22 $222M, FY23 $87.4M, FY24 $68.3M, and FY25 $29.8M. Tutor Perini’s FY2026 obligations are concentrated in a single market. Commercial and Institutional Building Construction accounts for $252M of obligations in FY2026 to date. Tutor Perini’s top buyer this fiscal year is the Department of Homeland Security, which accounts for $248M of obligations. Tutor Perini also has smaller obligations with the Department of the Interior and the Department of Defense, at $1.6M and $1.5M respectively, and with the General Services Administration at $650K. Figures are contract obligations except for award-value figures in the largest-awards and expiring-contracts tables, which are total contract values. Current-year totals are partial (fiscal year to date).
